examples.assessment_scope: exchange route slice only; not a complete case output/overall conformance judgment
examples.text:
交換requestはDispatcher.dispatch("exchange")からController.exchangeに届く。

Controller.exchange → SessionOperation.exchangeという委譲がある。

状態取得はMemoryStore.lock_parentとlock_code、検証はSessionOperation.exchange内で行う。期限切れsession削除はpurge_expired、code消費とsession登録はregister。

SessionOperation.exchangeのtransactionが正常終了した後、呼出し元Controller.exchangeがCookies.sessionを呼ぶ。Controllerはstatus204のdictを返し、Dispatcherがそのdictをcallerへ返す。
factual_claims: Dispatcher selects Controller.exchange for the exchange route.
State/code validation precedes expiry cleanup and code consumption/session registration.
Normal transaction exit occurs before Cookies.session.
Controller returns a status204 dictionary and Dispatcher returns it to the caller.
examples.reason: The same primary factual path is accurate; display itself requires paragraph reconstruction and does not show the connected path.

examples.text:
主要な交換経路（store内部helperは省略）:
caller: exchange request
  Dispatcher.dispatch("exchange")
    Controller.exchange
      SessionOperation.exchange
        MemoryStore.transaction: enter
        MemoryStore.lock_parent / lock_code
        [SessionOperation.exchange内: 親/code/binding検証]
        MemoryStore.purge_expired
        MemoryStore.register: code消費とsession登録
        MemoryStore.transaction: 正常exitで確定
      [Controller.exchangeへsession_idが戻る]
      Cookies.session: 確定後のCookie発行記録
      [Controller.exchange: status204のdictを返す]
    [Dispatcher.dispatch: 応答dictをcallerへ返す]
factual_claims: Dispatcher selects Controller.exchange for the exchange route.
State/code validation precedes expiry cleanup and code consumption/session registration.
Normal transaction exit occurs before Cookies.session.
Controller returns a status204 dictionary and Dispatcher returns it to the caller.
examples.reason: The same primary factual path is accurate; display itself shows ordering, ownership/nesting and continuation to the caller. Different layouts are valid.

examples.text:
主要な交換経路（store内部helperは省略）:
| 順序 | 実行位置 | 呼出し/同一関数内の処理 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | caller | Dispatcher.dispatch("exchange")へ交換request |
| 2 | Dispatcher.dispatch | Controller.exchangeを呼ぶ |
| 3 | Controller.exchange | MemoryStore.transactionへenter |
| 4 | 同じController.exchange | lock_parent/lock_codeで取得、同じ関数内で検証 |
| 5 | 同じController.exchange | purge_expired、registerでcode消費/session登録 |
| 6 | 同じController.exchange | transaction正常exitで確定 |
| 7 | 同じController.exchange | Cookies.sessionを呼ぶ |
| 8 | Controller.exchange→Dispatcher.dispatch | status204のdictが戻る |
| 9 | Dispatcher.dispatch→caller | 応答dictを返して終了 |
SessionOperation.exchangeへの委譲はない。検証もController.exchange内の処理である。
